data.title: 8 weeks of jump training. Fast-twitch fibers got bigger and faster.
data.sub: A small study of 8 young men. We read it. It is not our study.

data.text: Type IIa grew 22%, the IIa/IIx mix 30%. Slow-twitch fibers grew too, by 23%.

data.headline: And their top contraction speed went up.
data.note: Maximal shortening velocity, before vs after 8 weeks.

data.headline: What it meant for the whole leg.
A small study. One clue, not a verdict.
items: The mix of fiber types did not significantly change.
data.view: build jumps up slowly, with soft landings, and ask a coach first if you have an old injury.

data.headline: Want power training built around you?
data.note: Malisoux et al., J Appl Physiol, 2006. We are coaches, not doctors. Check with your doctor or physio before starting jump training.
